Subject: Technical Onboarding Workshop — SE walk-through & security Q&A

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I want to get a focused technical onboarding/workshop on the calendar so our SE (Dylan) can do a deep-dive with your engineers, and your procurement/security folks can get their questions answered. Suggested outcomes:

- SE walk-through of integration and expected performance at your traffic profile
- Security Q&A (data flows, retention, KMS options) with Markus or your security lead
- Procurement checklist + next steps for SOW/PO

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Jul 13, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jul 14, 09:00–10:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu Jul 15, 11:00–12:30

Attached is a short pre-demo checklist and the network requirements we typically review. Please let us know preferred times and who from your side will join (engineer + security + procurement). I can send a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Attachments: [pre-demo-checklist.xlsx] [network-requirements.txt]

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez

Sergio —

Appreciate the options. We definitely want Dylan to lead the technical portion — Markus Voss (security) and I will be on for the Q&A. I’ve looped in Priya from procurement to start the contracting thread.

Two notes:
1) The Tue Jul 13 morning slot conflicts with a steering committee for us. The earliest we can do this week is Wed Jul 14 after 09:30 ET (so ~06:30 PT). Late afternoon PT is better for Markus.
2) Can Dylan include a short bit (10–15 min) on runtime isolation and KMS integration? Markus will want that upfront.

If you can propose final times in ET, that’ll help us lock with our calendar. Also, can you share a short SOW (even a draft) we can circulate with procurement?

Thanks —
Alex Jenkins
Director, Cloud Engineering — Acme Hosting
alex.jenkins@acmehosting.com

Thanks Alex — happy to run the session. Quick replies to the asks:

- I will plan a short KMS/runtime isolation slide + demo (15 min) at the top of the session.
- Typical workshop outline (60–90 min):
  1) 10m intros + goal alignment
  2) 25m integration patterns & demo (prefix caching, batching, KV cache)
  3) 15m security & KMS deep-dive + config notes
  4) 10–15m troubleshooting / next steps

Availability (ET):
- Wed Jul 14: 12:00–13:30 ET (best)
- Wed Jul 14: 17:00–18:30 ET (OK, if Markus prefers late afternoon)
- Thu Jul 15: 14:00–15:30 ET (also possible)

Network note: we’ll need outbound 443 and TCP 10250 open for the probe agent; attaching the short network requirements.

Attachment: [network-requirements.txt]

If Wed 12:00 ET works for everyone that would be my preference. Sergio, happy for you to send the invite.

—Dylan
